# goto

Jump to a Lua label in the current function.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `lua.keyword.goto` |
| Origin | Lua base |
| Category | Lua Base |
| Family | Keyword |
| Monaco kind | `keyword` |
| Format | `goto <label>` |
| Valid contexts | `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `goto label` |

## Example

```lua
goto label
```
